motion_meaning: Dots are schematic data flow; probability surfaces are actual saved fitted stages, not measured runtime.
static_alt: Side-by-side educational infographic: logistic regression forms one linear feature score and applies a sigmoid; gradient boosting adds tree scores before applying a sigmoid. Fitted probability surfaces on the same synthetic two-moons data show their different shapes. Guidance compares an inspectable baseline with extra nonlinear flexibility, with validation and no universal winner.
clip_description: 20-second silent educational comparison. The left model stays fixed; the right surface replays actual fitted boosting stages1,5,10,20,30. Moving dots illustrate data flow, not timing. Synthetic data, not churn results.
